fields.name: The site's primary domain.
fields.status: How far the install got, like installed or installing.
fields.url: The address Forge shows for the site.
fields.user: The Linux user the site runs as.
fields.https: Whether Forge has TLS turned on for the site.
fields.web_directory: The directory nginx serves from, like /public.
fields.root_directory: The site's root directory on the server.
fields.aliases: The other domains pointed at this site.
fields.php_version: The PHP version the site runs, formatted like PHP 8.3.
fields.deployment_status: Only set while a deploy is running. Otherwise empty.
fields.quick_deploy: Whether Forge deploys by itself on every push.
fields.isolated: Whether the site runs under its own Linux user.
fields.shared_paths: The directories carried across zero-downtime releases.
fields.repository: The git repository, branch and provider the site deploys from.
fields.database: The name of the database Forge made for the site.
fields.maintenance_mode: Whether the site is in maintenance mode.
fields.zero_downtime_deployments: Whether deploys swap in an atomic release.
fields.deployment_retention: How many old releases Forge keeps on disk.
fields.deployment_script: The commands Forge runs on each deploy.
fields.wildcards: Whether a wildcard subdomain points at the site.
fields.app_type: The kind of app, like laravel or Custom.
fields.uses_envoyer: Whether Envoyer handles deploys instead of Forge.
fields.deployment_url: A URL that triggers a deploy with no sign-in.
fields.healthcheck_url: The URL Forge pings to check the site is healthy.
fields.environment: The site's env file. Forge keeps it on a separate endpoint.

fields.name: The server's name in Forge.
fields.slug: The server's slug, used in its Forge URL.
fields.type: What the server is set up as, like app or worker.
fields.provider: The hosting provider, like ocean2 or a custom VPS.
fields.identifier: The provider's own id for the machine.
fields.credential_id: The saved provider key Forge built the server with. Empty on a custom VPS.
fields.size: The provider's plan or instance size.
fields.region: The provider region the server runs in.
fields.ubuntu_version: The Ubuntu release on the server.
fields.php_version: The PHP version new sites get by default, formatted like php83.
fields.php_cli_version: The PHP version the command line uses, formatted like php83.
fields.database_type: The database engine installed, like mysql8 or postgres16.
fields.db_status: Whether the database is installed and running.
fields.redis_status: Whether Redis is installed and running.
fields.connection_status: Whether Forge can reach the server over SSH.
fields.revoked: Whether Forge has been disconnected from the server.
fields.local_public_key: The server's own SSH public key. A git host uses it as a deploy key.

fields.commit: The commit deployed, with its hash, branch, message and author.
fields.status: Where the deploy got to: pending, queued, deploying, finished, failed, failed-build or cancelled.
fields.updated_at: When the deploy record last changed.

fields.description: What the event did, like Adding database.
fields.ran_as: The server user the event ran as.
fields.updated_at: When the event record last changed.
